HOME.HERO_TITLE: Your technology, sorted — fast, and for less.
HOME.HERO_SUBTITLE: We build fast websites, automate busywork with AI, untangle databases and fix computers, networks and clouds — for homes, offices and businesses across Sydney. A small team, AI-assisted work and no advertising budget mean you pay less and get more.
HOME.WHY_LEAD: Small, smart and honest => get more and pay less.
HOME.WHY1_TEXT: AI-assisted diagnosis and experienced technicians — fixes that stay fixed, with nothing left to patch up later.
HOME.WHY2_TEXT: A small team and no advertising budget — the savings go straight into lower prices for you.
HOME.WHY3_TEXT: Same-day response and quick jobs. Most problems are fixed within a day or two.
HOME.WHY4_TEXT: Honest advice and clear, fixed pricing. We tell you what needs fixing and what doesn't.
HOME.SERVICES_LEAD: Six ways we keep Sydney running — from a one-person studio to a growing company.
HOME.SERVICE_WEB_TEXT: Fast, mobile-friendly websites and web apps — designed, built, hosted and maintained by us. From a one-page site to a customer portal, tell us what it should do and we'll take care of the rest.
HOME.SERVICE_AI_TEXT: Put AI to work on the repetitive stuff — document and data extraction, smart assistants, report generation and workflow automation that saves hours every week.
HOME.SERVICE_DB_TEXT: Database design, migration, tuning and pipelines. We make your data reliable, fast to query and safe — whether it's SQL Server, PostgreSQL or the cloud.
HOME.SERVICE_DB_ALT: Server rack in a data centre
HOME.SERVICE_CLOUD_TEXT: Deployments, CI/CD, cost reviews and cloud migration on AWS and Azure — systems that scale when you need them and stay cheap when you don't.
HOME.SERVICE_CLOUD_ALT: Cloud data centre with active equipment
HOME.SERVICE_PC_TEXT: Slow computers, broken laptops, patchy Wi-Fi, internet down? We diagnose and fix most problems the same day — on-site or remotely.
HOME.SERVICE_SUPPORT_TEXT: Ongoing support and honest advice with clear, fixed pricing. We tell you what needs fixing, what doesn't, and charge what we quoted.
HOME.PROCESS_LEAD: Four steps from "it's broken" to "it just works".
HOME.PROCESS1_TEXT: Email or call with what's happening. We reply the same day and ask the right questions.
HOME.PROCESS2_TEXT: We find the real cause and give you a clear, fixed price before any work starts.
HOME.PROCESS3_TEXT: AI-assisted diagnosis plus experienced hands. Most jobs are done within a day or two.
HOME.PROCESS4_TEXT: We test the fix, show you it works, and stay available afterwards — no lingering problems.

HOME.ABOUT_P1: FengTech is a Sydney IT team that works smarter, not bigger. We pair decades of full-stack and database engineering with the latest AI tools, keep the team small and skip the advertising budgets — and pass the savings on to you.
HOME.ABOUT_P2: The same hands that build production systems for fintech and wealth-tech also fix home Wi-Fi and small-business websites. Take this site as an example: built with AI assistance, running with zero ongoing costs, and fully ours — cheap, fast and finished properly.
HOME.ABOUT_QUOTE: Faster, cheaper, and fixed right the first time.
HOME.FAQ1_A: We're based in Sydney and cover the metro area on-site. For websites, cloud, databases and software work, we help clients anywhere remotely.
HOME.FAQ2_A: Every job gets a clear, fixed quote before we start — no hourly surprises. Because we keep the team small and don't advertise, our rates are below the big providers.
HOME.FAQ3_A: We reply to email the same day. Urgent computer and network issues can usually be seen the same day or the next.
HOME.FAQ4_Q: Do you work with small businesses?
HOME.FAQ4_A: Yes — that's who we're built for. Homes, sole traders and growing businesses of every size, from a one-off fix to ongoing support.
HOME.FAQ5_A: Most software, website, database and cloud work is done remotely. For hardware, Wi-Fi and network issues, we come to you in Sydney.
HOME.CONTACT_LEAD: Email is the fastest way to reach us. Tell us what's going on and we'll reply the same day.
